mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_role_menu (tenant_id, role_id, menu_id, created_by, updated_by) SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id, #{menuId}, #{actorId}, #{actorId} FROM iam_role r JOIN plat_tenant t ON t.id = r.tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND (r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' OR (r.is_system = 1 AND r.data_scope_type = 'ALL' AND r.role_code IN ('platform_super_admin', CONCAT(t.tenant_code, '_super_admin')))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_role_menu grant_record WHERE grant_record.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND grant_record.role_id = r.id AND grant_record.menu_id = #{menuId} AND grant_record.deleted = 0 )
